title_en: On November 25, 2569, Major-General Napdal Pramatmak, Commander of the Special Operations Unit (SOTU) of the 46th Ranger Regiment in Rueso Township, Narathiwat
summary_en: On November 25, 2569, Major-General Napdal Pramatmak, Commander of the Special Operations Unit (SOTU) of the 46th Ranger Regiment in Rueso Township, Narathiwat Province, assigned troops from the ranger battalion to follow up and monitor water level situation in at-risk areas with community leaders, especially those affected by recurring flood problems.
